quote: A strong validator might change for reasons other than a change to the representation data
anchorObserved: §8.8.1 "Weak versus Strong", paragraph defining a strong validator; earlier in §8.8.3 "ETag": "An entity tag is an opaque validator" (single-line text view line 1)
reason: Both clauses of teaches are still present verbatim: §8.8.3 defines an entity tag as "an opaque validator for differentiating between multiple representations of the same resource", and §8.8.1 says a strong validator "might change for reasons other than a change to the representation data, such as when a semantically significant part of the representation metadata is changed (e.g., Content-Type)". Scope (HTTP validator semantics for entity tags) and anchor (§8.8.1 Weak versus Strong, §8.8.3 ETag, Published: June 2022 per RFC header) are unchanged; RFC 9110 is a published immutable spec, so only availability and anchor placement were at issue.
